steps.name: Ash Tree Evening
steps.objective: Visit [Embla] in “Nidaros” to check the story, and click the [Quest Complete] button to end the quest.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I can’t drink any more… . Hmm, hmm... . If this continues, my stomach will explode and I will die.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Why on earth is this guy drinking something he can’t even win… .

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Hey, go home. Please go away. I can't even do business... . Go ahead. If you don't go, they'll throw it outside?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Uncle Stellan. Hmm... . I did as you said. Hmm... . Nidaros and Embla will be fine now... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Don't worry too much... … … . Hmm... .

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Askren, do you think I don't know?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I'll wait. Please tell me properly when the time comes... .

steps.name: cousins' evening
steps.objective: Visit [Carmen] in “Nidaros” to check the story, and click the [Quest Complete] button to end the quest.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: One, two, three, glissad assamble… .

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Hey, you got the beat wrong! All you have to do is just shout it out, so why get it wrong?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: You know this?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: No. Try again.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: One, two, three, glissad assamble… .

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: It's off beat. Was it my younger brother Bachchi?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Oh, I guess that's right... .

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Hey, why does my sister order this? I don't even dance.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: You said you were sorry? You said you would listen well?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Okay. Then I'll do something else. Are you really doing something different?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Is this right?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: One, two, three, Dombe Padvre.
(Carmen diligently practices her movements following Lars’ commands.)

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: One, two, three, glissad assamble… . Rest, one, two, three, dombe padvre… .

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Sister, you are doing well. It's better than before.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: If you didn't hear it, don't.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I heard it clearly with these ears. ‘Sister, you are doing well. I said, ‘It’s so much better than before, it’s so great!’

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I didn't say that much! I didn't do it!

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Hehe, good guy. Ah, how it feels. If you audition for the Plata Dance Company and perform as the main dancer, I will put you in a good position.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Huh? Have you been planning on not inviting your family?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Lars, what is it? It's touching. I thought your sister would naturally join.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Ah, that's enough.  Just do it quickly.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: One, two, three, glissad assamble… . One, two, three, Dombe Padvre.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: What's next? Speak quickly. If I don't say anything, I'm going home?
